purpose.summary: ORCR0300 is a batch program that creates/edits receipt (レセプト) electronic claim files in CSV format for the JMA (Japan Medical Association) ORCA standard medical-receipt software system. It reads multiple indexed receipt detail files (RECE02–RECE11) and writes formatted claim records, handling insurance history, surgical history, diagnosis details, drug/device items, comments, and various regional/prefectural billing rules.
purpose.domain: healthcare / medical billing (Japanese national health insurance claims processing)

notable_features: No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — pure file-based batch processing
Multiple INDEXED files with DYNAMIC access (RECE02, RECE03, RECE04, RECE05, RECE09, RECE11)
COPY statements referencing external copybooks (.INC files: CPRCF002, CPRCF0031, CPRCF0041, CPRCF005, CPRCF009, CPRCF011)
Extensive Japanese-language comments (EUC-JP / latin-1 decoded, hence garbled in ASCII view)
Detailed revision history spanning 2003–2006 with named developers
No COMP-3 usage despite numeric processing (uses PIC X and PIC 9 fields)
Open-source JMA ORCA project (Japan Medical Association)
verdict.notes: File decoded as latin-1 but comments are actually Japanese EUC-JP encoded, appearing garbled. The program is part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system. Source is truncated at 16000 chars out of ~288KB; the full program is substantially larger. No COMP-3 fields visible in the truncated portion despite arithmetic operations, which is slightly unusual but not disqualifying. The .INC copybooks are referenced via COPY but not inlined, so copy_count=0 in the mechanical indicators reflects only inline COPYs counted differently.
